summary: Null-guarded field read: returns the 32-bit value at *(a2 + 12) when both arguments are non-null, otherwise 0. The first argument (a1) is only tested for non-null and is otherwise unused. In the caller InitializeMediaSurfaceFromStream (0x0050210E) the returned value is stored as the row stride of a media-surface context.

local_names.a1: guard-only argument; tested for non-null but never dereferenced
local_names.a2: object whose dword at +12 is read

operations.description: Both-arguments guard: when a1 or a2 is null the function returns 0 immediately without dereferencing a2.
Return the dword at *(a2 + 12) when both a1 and a2 are non-null; in the caller this value becomes the row stride written to the media-surface context (this[12]).

unresolved: The meaning of the value at a2+12 (interpreted by the caller as a row stride) is not independently confirmed by this function's own evidence.
The role of a1 is unknown: it must be non-null for the read to happen but is never otherwise used.
